DiagramService
|-- Public content-writing boundary
|   |-- create(input); revise(baseRevisionId, edit); generate(request, options?)
|   |-- getRevision(revisionId); listRevisions(diagramId)
|   `-- The service is the sole diagram content writer
|-- RevisionedDiagramService internals
|   |-- create -> DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate -> issue [calls]
|   |-- revise -> getRevision -> prepareEdit; changed result -> issue [calls]
|   |-- An unchanged edit returns the existing revision
|   |-- issue -> diagramRevisions.register(record) [call]
|   `-- Node correspondence preserves prior nodeRefs; new nodes receive UUIDs
`-- Generation adapter
    |-- DiagramGenerator.generate(request, options): Promise<Omit<DiagramInput, 'id' | 'revision'>>
    |-- Requests can include agent context, a base revision and diagram selection
    |-- generate -> generator.generate(cloned request) -> revise | create [calls]
    `-- Missing generators, mismatched bases and aborted signals reject generation
